people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon

people.name: Shimeah
people.line: Brother of David; father of Jonadab (or 'Jonathan').

people.name: Tamar
people.line: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon

translations.web: Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
translations.bsb: But Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah, spoke up: “My lord must not think they have killed all the sons of the king, for only Amnon is dead. In fact, Absalom has planned this since the day Amnon violated his sister Tamar.
translations.kjv: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
translations.asv: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
